Full job description

WP CodeUs, a WordPress development agency based in Rochester, Minnesota, is seeking an experienced Acumatica integration developer for a remote contract engagement running through December 2026.

We’re building a custom WooCommerce product configuration and ordering platform for a client. Our team handles the WordPress and WooCommerce development. Your role will focus on ensuring the custom order data and workflows work correctly with Acumatica.

The client has an existing WooCommerce-to-Acumatica connector and an internal developer who maintains and manages their website who will collaborate with us. You’ll review that integration, help establish the technical approach, and support implementation, testing, and launch.

Responsibilities

Review the existing connector and verify how products, orders, fees, and shipping information flow into Acumatica.
Guide SKU mapping and order data structure for customized products.
Determine how custom configuration details should be passed to or accessed from Acumatica.
Help define how automated vendor purchase orders fit into the existing workflow.
Identify and implement any agreed integration changes.
Test complete order flows, troubleshoot issues, and support launch.

Required experience

Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Acumatica integrations.
Experience working with Acumatica APIs and integration endpoints.
Understanding of product and SKU mapping, sales orders, and purchase order workflows.
Ability to review an existing integration and recommend practical changes.
Clear communication and comfort collaborating with another development team.

Preferred experience

Connecting Acumatica with WooCommerce or another ecommerce platform.
Custom order data, configurable products, or automated vendor fulfillment.
Integration error handling, logging, and duplicate-order prevention.

Contract details

Location: Remote
Engagement: Contract
Timeline: Start as soon as available, continuing through December 31, 2026
Hours: Vary based on project needs, with involvement during planning, implementation, testing, and launch
Compensation: Hourly rate based on experience

How to apply

Apply through Indeed with your resume or relevant project history. Include a brief description of an Acumatica integration you personally implemented, your role, and any ecommerce platforms involved.

Please also provide your requested hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

Pay: $70.00 - $95.00 per hour
